purpose: Teach: 重なり/言い回し/輪郭/際立っ/押さえる/手腕/旧式/ずさん

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 各部署の責任、重なりがある場合の整理、進めろ。
lines.en: Get the overlapping section responsibilities organized.
lines.style: Measured authority. Clipped, decisive pace. Eyes forward. Not unkind, but final—this is what needs doing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社外向けの言い回し、統一中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're standardizing how we present to external partners.
lines.style: Steady, competent tone. Shoulders level. Speaking as someone tracking the work closely, not performing efficiency.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 事業計画の輪郭、明確にしろ。
lines.en: Make the business plan outline sharper.
lines.style: Quiet weight behind the words. Slight lean forward. Not rushed—deliberate. The tone of someone who sees where this needs to land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合と際立った差別化、目指します。
lines.en: Yes. We're aiming for clear differentiation from competitors.
lines.style: Confident without rushing. Voice level, assured. The tone of someone who has already thought this through and is naming it aloud.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 予算、しっかり押さえる体制を。
lines.en: Build the systems to lock down the budget tightly.
lines.style: Businesslike finality. No softening. Brief. The voice of someone who has seen budgets slip before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 担当の手腕、若手にも見せたいです。
lines.en: I want to show the younger staff what good management looks like.
lines.style: Lighter tone underneath—genuine. Speaking to someone he trusts. Quiet conviction, not performing it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 旧式の業務、刷新する時期だ。
lines.en: It's time to overhaul the outdated processes.
lines.style: Slow, considered. Not harsh, but certain. The voice of someone observing something that has needed changing for a while.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ずさんな運用、改めていきます。
lines.en: Yes. We'll fix the careless gaps in how we're operating.
lines.style: Steady responsibility in the voice. Direct acknowledgment. No excuse-making, just saying what will happen.
